# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published version of each userscript is supported. Tampermonkey installations should use the raw GitHub URLs listed in the repository README so versioned updates can be received.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a report that contains a credential, customer information, a private screenshot, or other sensitive evidence. Email [jas@nortronic.com](mailto:jas@nortronic.com) with:

- the affected userscript and version;
- a concise description of the impact and reproduction steps;
- redacted evidence that does not contain live credentials or customer data; and
- any suggested remediation, if available.

If a live credential has been exposed, stop using it and arrange revocation or rotation with its owner immediately. Removing it from the current file does not remove it from Git history or previously downloaded copies.
